messages: Sandeep: seeing gpu-serve jobs timing out across us-west-2 — multiple pods failing with tcp timeouts when talking to kv-sync. Any recent network changes? Maria: same here, spike in restarts and long tail latencies. Observability shows a ton of retransmits on pod-to-pod flows. cc @Tom Tom: looking now. Pulled tcpdump on node-gpu-3 — lots of 'frag needed' ICMP and MSS errors. Also seeing RDMA handshake failures; ibv_rc_pingpong is returning errors. deploy-bot: deploy: netpol-update applied by Alyssa at 2026-03-31T12:02Z (PR #4321) Sandeep: that netpol-update rings a bell — it was supposed to lock down egress from platform. Can someone paste the policy? Tom: kubectl get networkpolicy netpol-restrict -n platform -o yaml apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1 kind: NetworkPolicy metadata: name: netpol-restrict namespace: platform spec: podSelector: {} policyTypes: - Egress egress: - to: - namespaceSelector: matchLabels: name: production ports: - protocol: TCP port: 443 Maria: uhoh — that only allows TLS to the production namespace on 443. Most other egress from platform namespace is blocked. Our gpu-serve pods live in 'gpu-tenant' namespace and the mesh sidecar opens high-port connections between namespaces — those are now blocked. Sandeep: makes sense why app-level connections fail. But why the MTU/ICMP fragmentation symptoms? Tom: earlier we rolled a CNI MTU patch for gpu nodes (hostNetwork workloads) to 9000 to support jumbo frames for RDMA. Non-gpu nodes are on 1500. Large packets originating on gpu nodes traverse nodes with 1500 MTU and routers send ICMP 'fragmentation needed' back. Path MTU discovery would shrink MSS, but our netpol is blocking ICMP egress (not allowed) so the frag-needed messages never reach the sender -> retransmits and handshake timeouts for RDMA. Alyssa: yep, I pushed the netpol tightening (my bad) to reduce noisy egress from platform. I didn't consider ICMP or ephemeral port ranges used by sidecars. Rolling a quick patch to allow necessary traffic. Alyssa: patching netpol to add explicit allow for gpu-tenant ns and ICMP + ephemeral ports: egress: - to: - namespaceSelector: matchLabels: name: production ports: - protocol: TCP port: 443 - to: - namespaceSelector: matchLabels: name: gpu-tenant ports: - protocol: TCP - protocol: ICMP - to: - ipBlock: cidr: 0.0.0.0/0 ports: - protocol: TCP port: 1024-65535 infra-bot: netpol-update applied by Alyssa at 2026-03-31T12:45Z (netpol-restrict updated) Maria: after the patch RDMA handshakes recovered, ibv_rc_pingpong shows normal RTTs, and retransmits dropped back to baseline. GPU job failures cleared. Sandeep: thanks everyone. Follow-up: add a preflight test that validates netpols don't block ICMP/PTU discovery or cross-namespace RDMA/ephemeral ports, and add a runbook item for MTU mismatches across node pools. Filing INFRA-789 to track. Tom: also recommend we avoid broad namespace-wide podSelector: {} denies for platform — use targeted podSelectors (monitoring-app pods) so sidecars and tenant workloads aren't impacted. Alyssa: agreed — I'll open PR to narrow the scope and add ICMP allowance to the platform policy. Maria: FYI added a short Slack alert: alertname=PodEgressBlocked, triggers when TCP retransmits > 5% for 5m across pods in gpu-tenant. Sandeep: perfect. :thumbsup:
